All 14 queries ran against the input files and gave the expected values. For T11, T12 and T14 I checked the answer by hand, and T13 matches my hand totals for its top two customers. The answers are:

| Task | Answer |
|---|---|
| T1 | 4 |
| T2 | `["alice","carol","erin","ivan"]` |
| T3 | `{"US":3,"DE":2,"unknown":2,"FR":2}` |
| T4 | 33.17 |
| T5 | `["bug","feature","performance","tests","urgent"]` |
| T6 | `[{number 106, assignee "carol"}, {number 102, assignee null}, {number 108, assignee null}]` |
| T7 | `{"alice":3,"bob":1}` |
| T8 | `["eslint@^8.56.0","express@^4.18.2","jest@^29.7.0","typescript@^5.3.3","zod@^3.22.0"]` |
| T9 | `"auth,reports,search"` |
| T10 | `{db 3, api 1, worker 1}` |
| T11 | 330.2 |
| T12 | 204.91 |
| T13 | `[{customer "Birch", total 109.97}, {customer "Acme", total 104.96}]` |
| T14 | `"elderberry-banana-cherry-apple-date-kiwi-fig"` |

- **T10:** qlang prints its keys as keywords (`:db`), not quoted strings.
- **T12–T13:** I took the price and quantity columns from the split lines by position and parsed them with `parseJson`.

T1: | /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count
T2: | /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) * /name
T3: | /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") * count
T4: | /data/users * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") * /labels | flat * (/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce null | if (eq null) ~(null) ~(/login))}
T7: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) * count
T8: | [/dependencies /devDependencies] | reduce {} ~(union) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) * ([(/0 | keyword) /1] | join "@")
T9: | /services | filter ~(allOf (at :enabled | eq true) (/port | gt 8000)) * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(ne "") * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) * count
T11: lines | * (split " ") * (filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") * (split ",") | filter ~(/5 | lower | eq "shipped") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") * (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") * (split ",") | filter ~(/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") * {:c /1 :t (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson))} | groupBy ~(/c) * (* /t | sum | round 2) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total /1} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
T14: | ["Banana" "apple" "Cherry" "banana" "fig" "APPLE" "date" "kiwi" "Fig" "elderberry"] * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
